lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity white pixel clusters are arranged in a staggered grid pattern along the mid-lateral line. At least three distinct horizontal rows are observable posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular nodes, forming a grid-like lattice across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, high-contrast horizontal line is present on the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a sharp luminance drop-off on the ventral side of the ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to moderate density of high-luminance circular clusters within the distal portion of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch on the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Single small yellow oval feature with vertical black bands located immediately anterior to the head.
